name: Rich Men of Harmouth
source:
Harmouth was known as a town for dreamers . Stories about miners who struck it rich in the mines kept on coming, bringing wealth and prosperity to the town.

That all changed; first, when the mine was exhausted and second, when a strange rash of disappearances hit the town. Without the gold mine to sustain it, Harmouth lost it's vitality. 

But while everybody else is getting poor, somebody has gotten rich. Interesting, that. Curious.

Very curious.

[From [url=https://posh-cat-studio.itch.io/rich-men-of-harmouth]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
哈茅斯被誉为梦想家之城。矿工们在矿井里致富的故事不断涌现，给小镇带来了财富和繁荣。

一切都变了；首先，当矿井耗尽时；其次，当一系列奇怪的失踪事件袭击小镇时。没有了金矿的支撑，哈茅斯就失去了活力。

但当其他人都在变穷时，却有人变富了。有趣的是，那个。好奇的。

很好奇。
